  ln=float(np.nansum(np.maximum(units,0)*(op-prevclose)));sn=float(np.nansum(np.minimum(units,0)*(op-prevclose)))

def independent(groups,period,price_kind):
 dates=market.dates;days=q.PERIODS[period];schedule=dates[::days];gmap={d:g for d,g in groups.groupby('TradingDay')};execmap={dates[dates.get_loc(d)+1]:d for d in schedule if dates.get_loc(d)+1<len(dates)-1}
 units=np.zeros(len(market.symbols));cash=prevnav=1.;rets=[]
 for t in range(1,len(dates)):
  mark=market.close[t];quote=(market.open if price_kind=='open' else market.close)[t];valid=np.isfinite(quote)&(quote>0);px=np.where(valid,quote,market.close[t-1]);oldnav=cash+np.nansum(units*px)
  if dates[t] in execmap or t==len(dates)-1:
   weights=np.zeros_like(units)
   g=gmap.get(execmap.get(dates[t])) if t!=len(dates)-1 else None
   if g is not None:
    for group,sgn in [(5,1),(1,-1)]:
     idx=market.symbols.get_indexer(g.loc[g.Group.eq(group),'SecuCode']);weights[idx]=sgn/len(idx)
   # Quote-missing positions are held; unavailable target positions are left as cash.
   lo=0.;hi=oldnav
   for _ in range(36):
    eq=(lo+hi)/2;target=np.divide(weights*eq,px,out=np.zeros_like(units),where=valid);target[~valid]=units[~valid]
    fee=.0015*np.nansum(np.abs(target-units)*px)
    if eq+fee>oldnav:hi=eq
    else:lo=eq
   target=np.divide(weights*lo,px,out=np.zeros_like(units),where=valid);target[~valid]=units[~valid]
   delta=target-units;fee=.0015*np.nansum(np.abs(delta)*px);cash-=np.nansum(delta*px)+fee;units=target
  nav=cash+np.nansum(units*mark);rets.append(nav/prevnav-1);prevnav=nav
 return perf(rets)
